prompt:
Create a complete, premium, cinematic modern Indian travel homepage for 'BharatVista Tours & Travels' (Tagline: 'हर सफ़र एक नई कहानी' / 'Har Safar, Ek Nayi Kahani'). The visual identity is directly anchored in the official BharatVista logo: a majestic color scheme of Deep Royal Navy (#0A2E4C), vibrant Sunset Saffron (#EA580C), Golden Temple Ochre (#D97706), Kerala Palm Emerald (#047857), and Desert Sandstone (#C2410C) against warm ivory (#FAFAF8) and deep midnight navy (#061727) surfaces. Typography pairs refined high-end editorial serifs with crisp modern geometric sans-serif for UI. Core philosophy: 'India itself is telling you a story'.

Page Structure & Components:
1. Sticky Header / Navigation: BharatVista brand mark, nav links (Explore, Destinations, Tours, Experiences, Stories, About, Contact), and a prominent Sunset Saffron 'Plan My Trip' CTA button.
2. Cinematic Hero Section: Expansive visual journey showing India's diverse wonders (snow-capped Himalayas, Rajasthani royal forts, Khajuraho temples, Mysuru palace, Kerala backwaters). Headline: 'Discover India, Your Way'. Tagline badge: 'हर सफ़र एक नई कहानी'. Primary CTA 'Explore Tours' and secondary CTA 'Plan My Trip'.
3. Quick Trip Planner Bar: Clean, integrated floating planner component immediately below hero with fields: Destination (e.g. 'Rajasthan, Kerala, Ladakh...'), Travel Month / Date, Travellers ('2 Travellers'), Budget Range ('Flexible / Premium'), and 'Plan My Trip' button.
4. Explore India Travel Categories: Editorial cards with rich photography for Heritage, Nature, Wildlife, Spiritual, Adventure, Culture.
5. Featured Destinations: Large luxury travel cards (Ladakh, Rajasthan, Kerala, Varanasi, Meghalaya) featuring high-impact imagery, short narrative excerpt, and 'Explore Destination' links.
6. Signature Tour Journeys: Modular package preview cards with destination tag, duration, highlights, 'Explore Tour' and 'Plan My Trip' actions.
7. Editorial Story Section: Magazine-style visual spread titled 'Every place has a story' with narrative vignettes and human-scale photography.
8. Why BharatVista: Clean value pillars (Personalized Journeys, India-Focused Travel, Thoughtful Planning, Real Human Assistance, Beyond-the-Usual Itineraries).
9. How It Works: Minimal visual 4-step sequence: 01 Discover, 02 Plan, 03 Connect, 04 Travel.
10. Final Cinematic CTA Banner: 'Your next story starts here.' with primary 'Plan My Trip' button.
11. Comprehensive Footer: BharatVista brand mark, tagline, full sitemap links, trust badges, copyright and legal placeholders.
